content.short: NillaConnect is the universal P2P leverage optimizer.
content.description: NillaConnect tackles capital inefficiency across short- and long-tail assets by helping users discover and create yield opportunities across chains, with automated, one-click execution. Suppliers earn higher yields through NillaConnect's P2P matching than traditional deposits, while borrowers gain control over borrowing costs when paired in P2P. Leveraging an N-Account, users unlock cross-chain opportunities that boost yields in protocols that may otherwise offer low returns.
